title: Teyo Verada | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Teyo Verada, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Teyo Verada is a young, inexperienced shield mage who was unexpectedly thrust into the chaos of war, surviving deadly trials against all odds. He’s still learning what it means to be a Planeswalker and has only scratched the surface of his true potential.
